title: Industrial Engineer (P2)
description:
**About Analog Devices**
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
Analog Devices is seeking an experienced Industrial Engineer to join the Central Industrial Engineering team. This role will lead high-impact initiatives focused on capacity modeling, factory scheduling, cycle time reduction, operations research, and productivity improvement across ADI's front-end manufacturing network. The successful candidate will drive development of cross-site analytical models, optimization tools, and data-driven decision systems that maximize factory output, support expansion planning, and establish standardized Industrial Engineering practices across multiple manufacturing sites.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead development of cross-site capacity models, utilization analyses, loading scenarios, and expansion planning studies.
* Drive cycle time reduction and WIP optimization initiatives through Factory Physics methodologies, bottleneck analysis, and constraint management.
* Develop and maintain advanced analytical tools supporting factory scheduling, output optimization, and operational decision making.
* Perform operations research and statistical analyses to identify key output levers and productivity improvement opportunities.
* Design and implement predictive models, optimization algorithms, and AI-enabled analytical solutions for manufacturing applications.
* Lead validation and continuous improvement of scheduling logic, factory planning assumptions, and manufacturing data structures.
* Establish standard methodologies, governance processes, and best practices across multiple manufacturing sites.
* Mentor junior Industrial Engineers and provide technical leadership on analytical projects.
* Partner with site leadership, operations teams, supply chain, manufacturing engineering, and IT to drive strategic improvement initiatives.
* Present recommendations, scenario analyses, and business cases to management and senior leadership.
* Support development of long-range capacity plans and fab expansion scenarios.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Manufacturing Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related engineering discipline.
* Proficiency in SQL, Python, Power BI, and statistical analysis tools.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Data Science, Analytics, or related field.
* Semiconductor wafer fabrication experience.
* Experience with Factory Physics, cycle time engineering, capacity planning, production scheduling, or manufacturing optimization.
* Experience with simulation, optimization modeling, machine learning, or operations research techniques.

**Work Experience**

* 3–5 years of Industrial Engineering experience in semiconductor manufacturing or other complex manufacturing environments.
* Experience building capacity models, productivity analyses, factory scheduling models, or optimization tools.
* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional improvement initiatives.
* Strong analytical, communication, and project leadership skills.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams is preferred.

*For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*
*Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group.*
Job Req Type: Experienced
  
  
Required Travel: Yes, 10% of the time
  
  
Shift Type: 1st Shift/Days

title: Transformation & Manufacturing Performance Leader
description:
* As Transformation & Performance Leader, reporting directly to the Plant Head, you will be responsible for driving manufacturing transformation through digitalization, automation, process optimization, and global best-practice deployment. You will work closely with global stakeholders, manufacturing teams, digital technology teams, and functional leaders to identify and implement initiatives that improve productivity, cost competitiveness, quality, delivery, capacity, and overall plant performance.
* You will translate business challenges into actionable transformation initiatives, leveraging global expertise, digital technologies, data analytics, and automation solutions to enhance manufacturing processes and operational effectiveness.
* You will drive the transformation roadmap, ensure effective execution of initiatives, and track measurable business benefits while collaborating with existing Manufacturing, Lean, and Advanced Manufacturing teams. You will foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, Safety, Quality, and leadtime.
* Visualize and collaborate with leadership team to transform Sanand Facility into a modern, digital Smart Factory.
* Factory Performance Management
* Establish and lead a structured factory performance monitoring through Digital Tools and Dashboards and review process covering key operational and business KPIs.
* Use Real Time Data to Monitor performance trends, identify gaps against targets, highlight risks, and drive timely corrective actions with functional leaders.
* Partner with Production, Planning, Quality, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Engineering and Project teams to develop and implement targeted improvement initiatives that deliver measurable operational and financial benefits.
* Partner with Operational Excellence/ Lean teams to establish a culture of continuous improvement, ownership, and accountability by embedding standard work, visual management, performance tracking, and best practices across manufacturing operations.
* Provide the Plant Head with actionable insights on factory performance, key improvement priorities, and progress against business objectives.
* Link operational performance gaps to improvement initiatives and ensure sustained results.
* Transformation Portfolio & Business Impact
* Lead the identification, prioritization, and execution of major factory transformation projects aligned with business priorities.
* Develop and maintain a transformation roadmap with defined objectives, milestones, responsibilities, investments, and expected benefits.
* Ensure that each major transformation project addresses a specific factory performance gap and delivers measurable operational or financial improvements.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams, remove implementation barriers, manage project interdependencies, and ensure timely execution.
* Track and validate project benefits in collaboration with Finance and functional owners, ensuring sustainability of results.
* Report transformation progress, risks, realized benefits, and support requirements to the Plant Head.
* Collaborate with External Experts and Consultants in driving major transformation projects
* Manufacturing Transformation, Digitalization & Automation
* Identify opportunities to improve manufacturing processes, productivity, throughput, quality, lead time, and cost competitiveness.
* Drive digitalization and automation initiatives in collaboration with global digital, IT/OT, manufacturing, and Advanced Manufacturing teams.
* Leverage global technologies, best practices, data analytics, and Industry 4.0 solutions to address plant performance challenges.
* Develop business cases and prioritize initiatives based on operational impact, feasibility, investment, and return on investment.
* Work in partnership with existing Manufacturing, Lean, and Advanced Manufacturing leaders, leveraging their expertise and ensuring alignment with ongoing initiatives.

Facilitate the deployment and scaling of successful solutions across the plant and global manufacturing network.
  
  

* Global Stakeholder Management & Change Leadership
* Act as a key interface between the plant and global stakeholders for manufacturing transformation, digitalization, automation, and performance improvement.
* Identify and adapt global best practices and proven solutions to meet plant-specific business requirements.
* Drive cross-functional alignment, stakeholder engagement, and change management to ensure successful implementation and adoption.
* Promote a data-driven, performance-oriented culture focused on accountability, innovation, Safety, Quality, and Leadtime.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Factory performance against agreed operational and business targets.
* Delivery of the transformation roadmap and major project milestones.
* Validated financial benefits and sustained productivity improvements.
* Improvement in manufacturing cost, lead time, quality, throughput, and capacity utilization.
* Digitalization and automation project outcomes, adoption, and return on investment.
* Timely closure of performance gaps and corrective actions.

**Qualifications**
**Basic Qualifications (Requirements)**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing, Automation, or a related engineering discipline. A master's degree or MBA in Operations Management or PG in Data Analytics is preferred.
* ~20+ years of experience in manufacturing, manufacturing engineering, operational transformation, digitalization, automation, or industrial operations, preferably in power-sector or heavy-engineering manufacturing.
* Proven experience in driving cross-functional improvement initiatives and delivering measurable business results.
* Good understanding of manufacturing processes, digital manufacturing technologies, industrial automation, and Industry 4.0 applications.
* Experience working with global teams, technology partners, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Ability to develop business cases, evaluate investments, and measure financial and operational benefits.
* Strong project management, analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and change leadership skills.
* Familiarity with ERP/SAP, manufacturing data analytics, digital dashboards, and project management tools is preferred.
* A proactive, hands-on, and results-oriented mindset with the ability to convert business challenges into practical solutions.
* Willingness to travel to global manufacturing locations and technology partners as required.

**Reporting Structure**
**Reports to:**
Plant Head
  
  
**Key Interfaces:**
Global Manufacturing and Digital teams, Advanced Manufacturing, Manufacturing, Lean, Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, IT/OT, Finance, and Supply Chain.
  
  
Join us and work with global teams to support global customers ! At Arabelle Solutions, we have team members of more than 49 nationalities spread across 16 countries.
  
  
At Arabelle Solutions, we know diversity makes teams and business stronger.

title: Quantitative Risk Analyst
description:
As a Risk professional you will monitor trends or changes in the behaviour of our trading strategies across all markets and asset classes during the market trading.

**Location**
- Gift City, Gandhinagar

**Shift**
- Evening (3.30pm to 11.30pm)

**Responsibilities:**

* Analyse large-scale financial data (market-generated or otherwise)
* Build dashboards from extracted insights
* Enhance existing in-house tools and trackers
* Improve established processes and procedures
* Work with seniors to perform analytical activities

**Qualifications:**

* 1-4 years of full-time work experience
* Strong Python programming
* Ability to work with SQL and NOSQL databases
* Understanding of financial instruments across asset classes
* Linux know-how
* ETL workflow and knowledge of REST-API
* Ability to learn and digest new technical ideas/tools and implement them

**Bonus points**

* Having cleared NISM certification (VIII and XVI)
* Ability to work on multiple tasks and prioritise
* Passion to automate day-to-day operations
* Willingness to learn and thrive in a highly dynamic environment

title: Python Developer_4+ years
description:
We are looking for a skilled
 **Python Developer with hands\-on experience in GenAI, FastAPI, LangChain, and LangGraph** 
 to develop scalable and production\-ready AI applications.
   

  

 The candidate will work on
 **LLM\-based applications, RAG solutions, conversational AI, and agentic workflows** 
 , along with enterprise API and system integrations. The role requires strong backend development skills and the ability to independently deliver high\-quality solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design and develop scalable REST APIs using FastAPI.
* Develop GenAI and LLM\-powered applications using Python.
* Build LLM workflows and integrations using LangChain.
* Design and orchestrate AI agents and state\-driven workflows using LangGraph.
* Develop RAG\-based applications, including retrieval, embeddings, and prompt orchestration.
* Build conversational AI solutions such as chatbots and virtual assistants.
* Integrate AI applications with enterprise systems, databases, APIs, and knowledge bases.
* Work with Azure cloud services, including Azure OpenAI, App Services, and Functions.
* Optimize applications for performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
* Collaborate with backend, UI, DevOps, and other engineering teams.
* Follow best practices for coding, testing, version control, and production deployment.


 Mandatory Skills
   

  

* Strong hands\-on experience in Python development.
* Hands\-on experience with FastAPI and REST API development.
* Strong experience with LangChain for LLM orchestration.
* Hands\-on experience with LangGraph for agent orchestration and state\-based workflows.
* Experience developing GenAI / LLM\-based applications.
* Experience with RAG and prompt engineering.
* Good understanding of REST APIs and microservices architecture.
* Experience integrating APIs and backend services.
* Working knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases and Git.


 Good to Have
   

  

* Azure OpenAI and Azure cloud experience.
* Microsoft Agent Framework.
* Microsoft 365 Agents SDK.
* Conversational AI / chatbot development.
* Agentic AI workflows.
* Vector databases and embeddings.
* Docker/containerization.
* CI/CD and DevOps practices.


 Education
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in
 **Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering** 
 , or a related field.
   

  

 Skills: python,gen ai,llm,langchain,langgraph
